title: Kosh Performance Report
description: Schema for the kosh performance report: LCP, CLS, load timings, console errors and failed network requests across several pages of a WordPress site, at desktop and mobile viewports. The measurements in pages[] come from the browser's page capture, not from the model. Renders through the standard QA renderer in scripts/generate-report.js.

url.description: The homepage URL the test started from.

websiteName.description: Site name from og:site_name, the WordPress site title, or the page title.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the test was run.

provenance.description: What produced this report, so runs can be compared across plugin versions, skill edits, and models.

model.description: Exact model ID the run was served by. For a skill's own output on Claude Code, read from the session log by scripts/run-qa-report.sh; elsewhere self-reported by the model, "unknown" when its system prompt does not state one. The only provenance field the skill writes.

modelSource.description: Where model came from: "transcript" is Claude Code's session log (the model that served the run's latest reply), "self-report" is the skill's own claim, used when there is no session log and when the report is re-rendered. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

effort.description: The reasoning effort the run's latest reply was sent at, from Claude Code's session log or its CLAUDE_EFFORT variable; absent on hosts that set neither. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

pluginVersion.description: kosh version from .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

skills.description: SHA-256 of each skill directory that produced the report, keyed by skill name. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

collectors.description: SHA-256 of the collectors/ directory, the page-side code Playwright MCP loads into every page, as it was on disk when the report was rendered. A session started before collectors/ changed ran the older code. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

playwrightMcp.description: The Playwright MCP arguments (the pinned version and its flags) in kosh's plugin.json when the report was rendered. A session started before plugin.json changed ran with the older ones. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

captureSha256.description: SHA-256 of the page capture archived beside the report as <name>.capture.jsonl, which a performance report's pages[] are built from. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

seal.description: SHA-256 over the report timestamp, pluginVersion, skills, collectors, playwrightMcp, captureSha256, model, modelSource and effort, marking the block as script-stamped for this run. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

environment.description: Environment the site was running in during the test. Defaults to production.

testMethodology.description: Short prose description of how the test was performed: pages and viewports, how timings were taken, and anything that affects how the numbers compare, such as a warm browser cache.

visitedPages.description: URLs of every page the test covered. Each must have a captured visit in pages[], or the report is refused.

pages.description: One row per page and viewport the browser loaded on the report's host, built from the page capture. Added by scripts/run-qa-report.sh — do not write this field.

explorationPass.description: Threads investigated beyond the checks, recorded whatever the outcome, so an observation outside this test's scope survives here instead of becoming a finding. Findings themselves live in `issues`.

check.description: What was examined, specific enough for someone else to repeat it.

outcome.description: no-issue = investigated and fine. finding-raised = became an entry in `issues`. inconclusive = cannot be settled without access not available during the run. out-of-scope = a real problem outside performance, in which case set `referredTo`.

detail.description: What was actually observed, including the evidence. For inconclusive outcomes, say what would settle it. For finding-raised, name the finding.

area.description: Surface this relates to, e.g. Images, Fonts, Scripts. Free text.

referredTo.description: For out-of-scope outcomes, the kosh test that covers this territory, e.g. a11y or functional-design.

webUrl.description: An http(s) URL of a page kosh navigated to. URLs observed on the site, such as a failed request's, are plain strings: a malformed one is something to report, not to fix in the JSON.

url.description: The page's URL after any redirects.

redirectedFrom.description: URLs that redirected to this one, as observed.

viewport.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT as the page saw it; null when no timing was read.

status.description: HTTP status of the document; null when it got no response.

failure.description: Why the document failed to load, e.g. net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED.

visits.description: Loads of this page at this viewport. Only the first is measured, since a revisit loads from a warm cache.

loadTime.description: loadEventEnd in milliseconds; null when not measured.

resourceTransferSize.description: Bytes transferred for subresources by the time of the load event; near zero on a warm cache.

loggedIn.description: Present when the page loaded for a logged-in WordPress user (its `logged-in` body class), so it also loaded the admin bar and logged-in tools a visitor doesn't.

lcp.description: Largest Contentful Paint in milliseconds, one lab load; null when the page reported none.

cls.description: Cumulative Layout Shift over the visit, up to 10 s after load, one lab load.

vitalsSettled.description: false when a new LCP candidate or layout shift arrived in the last second before the read ended, or when Chrome's buffer of 150 layout shifts filled, which makes `cls` a lower bound; null when not read.

level.description: error, warning, or pageerror for an uncaught exception.

source.description: The script URL that logged it.

console.description: Console errors and warnings, and uncaught exceptions, from every visit to this page at this viewport.

status.description: HTTP status; null for a request that got no response, such as blocked mixed content.

failure.description: The browser's reason for a request that got no response.

resourceType.description: Resource type, e.g. script, stylesheet, image, font.

network.description: Failed subresource requests only: status 400 and up, or no response.

truncated.description: true when a visit stopped recording rows at its limit.

category.description: Performance = LCP or CLS outside the good band. JavaScript = console errors from JS failures. Network = failed resource requests. MixedContent = HTTP resources on HTTPS pages. ServerError = 5xx server-side failures.

issue.description: What is wrong, naming the specific resource, page or behavior.

device.description: Which viewport the issue was observed on.

pages.description: URLs where the issue was observed.

metric.description: The measurement behind the finding, e.g. 'Load time 3.4s (target < 3s)'.

screenshots.description: Paths relative to the reports/ directory, e.g. 'screenshots/homepage-network-tab.png' for a file saved at reports/screenshots/homepage-network-tab.png.
